caption: The drawing depicts a wooden display cabinet with a glass upper section and a solid lower section. The cabinet is hexagonal in shape, with three visible glass panels in the upper half—one on the front, and one on each side—supported by wooden framing. The glass panels are clear, showing empty shelves inside. The lower section is made of wood with decorative carved rectangular panels on the front and sides, each bordered with scalloped edging. The front lower panel has a metallic handle attached to it. The cabinet stands on four small wheels, two of which are visible at the front corners. The wood is shown in shades of light to medium brown, while the glass is rendered with light shading to provide transparency. The lines and shading create a realistic representation and the background is a plain light beige color.
title: Show Case
